target.title: fix(models): clear stale auth cooldowns after early limit resets
target.body:
Related: #70903

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who resolve a provider usage or billing condition before its recorded reset time can remain stuck on fallback because the saved auth profile is still locally blocked.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a profile-scoped `openclaw models auth clear-cooldown <profile-id>` command that reuses the existing locked reset operation, targets the persisted owner of inherited profiles, verifies the authoritative stored result, and prints the safe-restart step needed to discard live Gateway bookkeeping. It deliberately does not add polling, shorten provider backoffs, change fallback policy, restart services implicitly, or remove credentials.

## User Impact

Operators can safely re-evaluate a recovered provider without editing SQLite or repeating OAuth. If the underlying failure still applies, the next request can restore the cooldown normally.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/models/auth.test.ts` — 45 passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/models-cli.test.ts` — 17 passed
- `node scripts/format-docs.mjs --check docs/cli/models.md` — clean
- `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs/cli/models.md` — passed
- Repeated change reviews covered command wiring, persisted-store ownership, lock failures, inherited object keys, Gateway refresh, and documentation
- Full source build and transactional Gateway deploy succeeded at `ef5e772aa9d1435bb5ff7ef5b0cfa7b29746732c`
- Live no-delivery agent proof after clearing the persisted state and safely restarting the Gateway completed on `openai/gpt-5.6-sol` with no fallback attempts
